notes.title: Controller support
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31962009/a183eda543680429f603430f1b1254effc12d159.jpg[/img]

The next update will feature controller support :) . You can choose between wheel or standard joystick. 

Wheel tested: Gembird STR-RACEFORCE
Joystick tested: Hama Black Force

Mappings:

-- Wheel --
B10 - Show / Hide menu
B9 - Change camera
Right pedal - Gas
Left Pedal - Brake / Reverse

--  Joystick --
B10 - Show / Hide menu
B9 - Change camera
B8 - Gas
B7 - Brake / Reverse

notes.title: New vehicle - Bowler 4x4
notes.notes:

notes.title: Release date pushed back, added features
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31962009/a22813d2d80f509d2277687ae83d6f4e2b82933a.jpg[/img]

Since work on the game seems to be going well I've pushed back the release date to March 20th. 

Also I've added vehicle upgrades(engine and downforce) and the possibility to change vehicle colors.

As a bonus - I am making a 3D model of a new vehicle, which I think most of you would love to see. Fingers crossed :) .
